name: Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited
summary: Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure management services business in Japan and internationally. The company offers consulting services, such as intellectual services for projects related to social environment development; construction surveys, design, supervision, GIS, spatial information, surveying, and measurement; traffic observation and analysis, and information processing; IT solutions related to construction management, measurement control, and asset management; and outsourcing and resource management related to human resources and business processes.
